name: proxyscope
description: Governance mutability inspector for EVM proxy contracts

scripts.build: npm run build -w @proxyscope/core && npm run build -w @proxyscope/cli
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @proxyscope/core && npm run build -w @proxyscope/api && npm run build -w @proxyscope/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @proxyscope/core && npm run dev -w @proxyscope/api
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules apps/*/node_modules apps/*/.next node_modules
